title: One brand, one app

slides.html: Different logger. Different software. No comparison.

slides.label: The problem
slides.html:
Every brand has its own desktop software.

  • AiM reads AiM files.
  • Unipro reads Unipro files.
  • Alfano reads Alfano files.
  • Starlane reads Starlane files.

slides.label: The problem
slides.html:
Teammate on a different brand?

Your laps and theirs can't sit side by side. Switching logger brand means starting your analysis again in a new app.

slides.label: Kart Connect
slides.html:
That is about to change.

One screen for every major logger brand.

Coming soon

captions:
Different logger. Different software. No comparison.

AiM, Unipro, Alfano and Starlane each come with their own desktop software, and each one only reads its own files. If your teammate runs a different brand, your data never meets.

That is about to change. Coming soon to Kart Connect.

Ever tried to compare your data with a teammate on a different logger?
